summary: Frontend-only retest of the member-page news scoping bug fix: PASS. I created two TEST posts through the API with the admin cookie: one ajtai-iskola, one kisbaconi-ovoda. On /tagintezmenyek/ajtai-iskola, member-news showed exactly 3 posts (the TEST post plus the 2 seeded ajtai-iskola posts). kisbaconi-ovoda showed only its 1 TEST post. nagybaconi-ovoda showed member-no-news ('Ehhez a tagintézményhez még nincs hír.') and no cards. nagybaconi-iskola and kisbaconi-iskola each showed only their own 2 seeded posts. Client-side navigation through the header dropdown, starting from home and then /noutati, gave the correct list each time with no stale items. Route: ajtai-iskola -> kisbaconi-ovoda -> nagybaconi-ovoda -> kisbaconi-ovoda -> ajtai-iskola -> nagybaconi-iskola -> kisbaconi-iskola. Direct page loads gave the same results. /noutati still lists all 8 posts (6 seeded + 2 TEST). Member galleries are still scoped: ajtai-iskola 1 photo, nagybaconi-iskola 3, kisbaconi-ovoda and nagybaconi-ovoda 0. The HU 'Titkárság' typo is fixed in i18n.tsx. Both TEST posts were deleted; 6 posts remain.
critical_code_review_comments: MemberInstitution: the member-no-news message only appears once news.data is loaded, and there is no error state. If /news fails, the section stays silently empty (minor).
The backend GET /news?institution filter is now unused by the frontend. Filtering on the client is fine at the current size (limit 500).
seed_data_creation: Temporary posts 53fb9923... (ajtai-iskola) and 085f59ad... (kisbaconi-ovoda) were created and then deleted. The DB is back to 6 seeded posts.

API login: POST /api/auth/login sets a cookie. An empty member-news grid has zero height, so wait with state='attached' or wait for member-no-news.
